definitions.explanation: A professionally licensed architect in Japan, qualified to design buildings and oversee construction projects.

examples.japanese: {建築士|けんちくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}した→依頼する：21376_irai⟧。
examples.english: I hired an architect to design the house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It is difficult to obtain the first-class architect license.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{建築士|けんちくし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配慮|はいりょ}した→配慮する：26831_hairyosuru⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She is a well-known architect who specializes in designing environmentally conscious homes.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (architecture/construction) and ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (professional/qualified person). In Japan, {建築士|けんちくし} is a legally defined professional title governed by the Architects Act ({建築士法|けんちくしほう}).

Japanese architect licenses are divided into three levels:
- ⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧: first-class architect (can design any building)
- ⟦{二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}→二級建築士：29182_nikyuukenchikushi⟧: second-class architect (limited to smaller structures)
- {木造建築士|もくぞうけんちくし}: wooden structure architect (limited to wooden buildings)

The ⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧ exam is notoriously difficult, with a pass rate typically around 10%.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧: first-class architect
- {建築士|けんちくし}{事務所|じむしょ}: architectural firm
- {建築士|けんちくし}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧: architect licensing exam
- {建築士|けんちくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}する→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧: to consult an architect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{建築家|けんちくか}→建築家：06082_kenchikuka⟧: architect (more general, emphasizes the creative/artistic aspect)
- {設計士|せっけいし}: designer/engineer (broader term)
